the issue's workflow state/status is Todo

ambiguity_effects.explain: In Linear the careful reading is that the issue is in the Platform team. The person-team parse is grammatically possible but strained; if adopted, any issue assigned to Priya Nair would qualify when Priya is in Platform, so Platform Mobile / Data Platform / Web issues assigned to her would become matches.

turn2.differences: No material difference. Author c1 covers Platform team, c2 covers assigned to Priya Nair, c3 covers Todo state; issue-type from step 1 is implicit because all candidates are issues.
turn2.naturalness_note: Reads as an ordinary work request: concise action plus team, assignee, and state filters, with no IDs or test-only hints.
